entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11023 of 2024
Applicant :- Vikram Gupta @ Vikram Bharti And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- D.P. Dutt Tiwari,Deepika Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant and the learned Aga
for State.

2.  This application has been filed with a prayer to quash the impugned charge sheet No.01 dated 20.9.2021 as well as summoning order dated 10.2.2022 passed in Criminal Case No.25636 of 2022,
arising out of Case Crime No. 0038 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mishrik, District Sitapur and entire criminal proceeding of Criminal Case No.( CIS) 25636 of 2022 registered against petitioners which is pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate - I, Sitapur.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate - I, Sitapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submit the matter has been compromised in terms of order dated 21st October, 2024 passed in Application U/S 482 No.9307 of 2024 ( Vikram Gupta and 3 Others Vs. State o fU.P. Through Principal Secretary, Home Lucknow and another ) , the trial court vide order dated 14.11.2024 has verified the compromise.

sentences.text: 4. Even today, learned counsel appearing for informant as well as learned counsel for State has acknowledged the same.
5. In view of the above, this petition is disposed off.

The proceeding of impugned charge sheet No.01 dated 20.9.2021 as well as summoning order dated 10.2.2022 passed in Criminal Case No.25636 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No. 0038 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mishrik, District Sitapur and entire criminal proceeding of Criminal Case No.( CIS) 25636 of 2022 registered against petitioners which is pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate - I, Sitapur is hereby quashed.
